> **Thesis.** A language model stops being mysterious once every boundary—tokens, tensors, weights, logits, loss, cache, and samples—can be traced and measured.

::: {.callout-note}
This is a living essay under active development. Each chapter is backed by a reproducible notebook and will be expanded during the 18-day sprint.
:::

## What the Reader Will Build

- A tokenizer and input/output embedding path
- Multi-head causal self-attention from tensor operations
- A modern decoder block with RMSNorm, RoPE, GQA, and SwiGLU
- A trainable Tiny GPT
- Cached autoregressive decoding and a latency/memory benchmark
- A model-anatomy script for inspecting real open-source checkpoints

## Reproducibility Checklist

- [ ] Colab links run from a clean runtime
- [ ] Package/model/data versions are pinned
- [ ] Random seeds and hardware are reported
- [ ] Plots include axes, units, and sample counts
- [ ] Cached and uncached logits have a numerical equivalence test
- [ ] Closed-model claims are sourced and labeled
- [ ] Failed experiments are documented
